actions.label: Retest the merged signer fix when released

comment.body: Thanks for confirming that MWB 0.102 and 0.103 fail while 0.101 works. The related mixed-signer fix in #51789 merged on November 4, but I cannot confirm that any released build contains it yet. Please retest once a build containing that change is available and share the version and result; no key reset or firewall changes are needed.

judgment.recommended_action: Group with51567 and the open51789 candidate, without claiming a proven identical local cause or shipped fix.
evidence: The reporter identifies Store installation and0.102.3001, and says both pairing and pressing New key fail with the same visible message.
Issue51567 covers the same local key-generation/pairing class. PR51789 explicitly targets the demonstrated mixed-Microsoft-signer rejection there and is currently open/unmerged.
This new report has no supplied diagnostics or discussion; its generic error does not prove a specific certificate, network or service failure.

A November 5 follow-up says the same pairing/New key error affects MWB 0.102 and 0.103, while 0.101 works, and points to a signer-certificate explanation; this is consistent with the existing mixed-signer investigation but does not prove the local cause.
judgment.rationale: Route the matching failure to the existing signer investigation. PR #51789 is now merged (0b1dd814) but no release containing that change has been established; the reported 0.102/0.103 results therefore do not demonstrate that the fix failed or shipped.
